name: LouLou & Luxe — Public Launching Soon (loulouandluxe.com) & Dev Storefront Branch (sbanerjee.cloud)

parameters.content:
## 🌸 LouLou & Luxe — Public Launching Soon vs `sbanerjee.cloud` Development Branch
- **Public Website (`https://loulouandluxe.com`):** Displays ONLY the **Launching Soon / Coming Soon** page.
- **Development & Testing Branch (`http://localhost:11434`):** Hosts the full interactive Storefront.
- **1-Time-Per-User Cookie Consent:** Stored in `localStorage` + `document.cookie` (365d) + PostgreSQL `loulou_cookie_consents`.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS loulou_cookie_consents (
  visitor_key VARCHAR(320) PRIMARY KEY,
  consent_level VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ALL',
  necessary_cookies BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  analytics_cookies BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  marketing_cookies BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  policy_version VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'v1.0-2026-10',
  region_code VARCHAR(16) DEFAULT 'US',
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

INSERT INTO loulou_cookie_consents (
  visitor_key, consent_level, necessary_cookies, analytics_cookies, marketing_cookies, policy_version, region_code, updated_at
)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.visitorKey }}',
  '{{ $json.consent_level }}',
  TRUE,
  {{ $json.analytics_cookies }},
  {{ $json.marketing_cookies }},
  '{{ $json.policy_version }}',
  '{{ $json.region_code }}',
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (visitor_key) DO UPDATE SET
  consent_level = EXCLUDED.consent_level,
  analytics_cookies = EXCLUDED.analytics_cookies,
  marketing_cookies = EXCLUDED.marketing_cookies,
  updated_at = NOW();

SELECT
  TRUE AS ok,
  'CONSENT_RECORDED' AS status,
  '{{ $json.consent_level }}' AS consent_level,
  {{ $json.analytics_cookies }} AS analytics_cookies,
  {{ $json.marketing_cookies }} AS marketing_cookies;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS loulou_cookie_consents (
  visitor_key VARCHAR(320) PRIMARY KEY,
  consent_level VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ALL',
  necessary_cookies BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  analytics_cookies BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  marketing_cookies BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  policy_version VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'v1.0-2026-10',
  region_code VARCHAR(16) DEFAULT 'US',
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

SELECT
  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM loulou_cookie_consents WHERE visitor_key = '{{ $json.visitorKey }}') AS "alreadyConsented",
  COALESCE((SELECT consent_level FROM loulou_cookie_consents WHERE visitor_key = '{{ $json.visitorKey }}' LIMIT 1), 'ALL') AS consent_level,
  COALESCE((SELECT analytics_cookies FROM loulou_cookie_consents WHERE visitor_key = '{{ $json.visitorKey }}' LIMIT 1), TRUE) AS analytics_cookies,
  COALESCE((SELECT marketing_cookies FROM loulou_cookie_consents WHERE visitor_key = '{{ $json.visitorKey }}' LIMIT 1), TRUE) AS marketing_cookies;
